title: fix(ui): a form view's layout horizontal puts labels beside fields, and the form page draws tabbed views as tabs
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8XQi523WdBYxKuvgxjLJtnJ)_
Fixes #26843

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: semantic

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:表单视图写 `layout: 'horizontal'` 时,字段标签在 sm 及以上宽度放到输入框左侧(手机上仍是上下排);分页表单不再把它改回 vertical;`/forms/:name` 与 `/f/:slug` 表单页把 `type: 'tabbed'` 画成每节一个页签。
- 为什么改:这三项都能保存发布,但控制台画出来和没写一样,作者以为生效了其实没有(声明即生效)。
- 风险与回滚:只改字段的排布 class 与表单页的分节渲染;vertical 与不写 layout 的表单输出逐字节不变(有测试钉住);回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx`(分页渲染与提交时跳到出错页签)、`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx`(`HORIZONTAL_FIELD_ITEM_CLASS`)、`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/TabbedForm.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tabbedLayout-26843.test.tsx`,预期 13 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

1. **`layout: 'horizontal'` draws something.** The shared form renderer (`@object-ui/components` `form`) used `layout` only to align its action row. A horizontal field item is now a two-column grid from `sm` up: a fixed label column (`minmax(0,10rem)`) and the control column, label on the control's first text baseline. Every child except the `label` (the control, its description, its message) is placed in the second column, so a label-less field and the help text line up under the control. Every class the arrangement adds is `sm:`-prefixed, so below `sm` the item is the vertical one. `vertical` and an absent `layout` take the old code path unchanged: same classes, same DOM. The label element, its `for` / `id`, and the control's `aria-*` attributes are not touched.
2. **`TabbedForm` passes `layout` through.** It built its form node with `layout: 'vertical'` whatever the form view said; it now forwards `schema.layout` (declared on `TabbedFormSchema` as `ObjectFormSchema['layout']`, the key `ObjectForm` already hands over in its spread).
3. **The console form page draws `type: 'tabbed'`.** `FormPage` (`/forms/:name`, `/f/:slug`) drew every section stacked. A tabbed form view with more than one section now draws one tab per section with the app's tabbed-form semantics: the tab key is the section's `name`, else its heading, else its position (`TabbedForm`'s rule), `defaultTab` opens first, `tabPosition` places the strip (top / bottom / left / right), a section hidden by its `visibleWhen` draws no tab, and the panels are force-mounted and CSS-hidden when closed. A submit carries every section's fields from the page's one `values` map, closed tabs included; a submit refused for a missing or faulted field opens the tab that holds it. A one-section tabbed view draws stacked, as `TabbedForm` draws no strip for one tab.
4. **In-place fix, same defect class: the form page's rows honour `layout: 'horizontal'` too.** `FormPage` renders its own rows (not the shared renderer) and never read `layout`, so after item 1 the form page would have been the one entry point still ignoring it. Its rows take the same arrangement (`HORIZONTAL_ROW_CLASS`). Same file as item 3, same gate families.

Docs: the `layout` row in `ui/packages/plugin-form/README.md` and the `FormSchema` block in `ui/content/docs/components/form/form.mdx` now say what each value draws. The `object-form` registration's input help already read "`horizontal` beside it" and is unchanged.

Changeset: `.changeset/26843-form-layout-horizontal-tabbed-page.md`, `minor` for `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/plugin-form` and `@object-ui/console`.

## Why

The card's rule is declared equals effective (ADR-0049): `layout: 'horizontal'` and `type: 'tabbed'` validate, save and publish, and the console drew them exactly as if they were absent. PR #27027 made the keys reach every console form entry point; this PR makes them draw.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (`packages/spec` not touched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes (ESLint on the changed files: 0 errors; the repo-wide run is CI's).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English, except the 维护者速读 section, which the dispatch order requires in Chinese.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/__tests__/form-layout-horizontal-26843.test.tsx` (5): the grid classes and the label as first child on a horizontal item; every class horizontal adds is `sm:`-prefixed and none is removed (stacked below `sm`); a label-less field keeps its control in column two; the labels still name their controls (text, textarea, checkbox); CONTROL: absent `layout` renders byte-identical to `vertical` (ids normalised), and horizontal differs.
- `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/tabbedFormLayout-26843.test.tsx` (3): a tabbed `ObjectForm` with `layout: 'horizontal'` draws both tabs' fields horizontal; CONTROLS for no `layout` and `vertical`.
- `ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tabbedLayout-26843.test.tsx` (13): one tab per section named by its heading with every panel mounted; `defaultTab`; tab click; `tabPosition: left` gives a vertical strip; a submit carries `title`, `notes` and a never-opened tab's `defaults` value; a refused submit opens the tab of the missing required field; CONTROLS: one-section tabbed and `type: 'simple'` draw stacked with no tab strip; horizontal rows (classes, label first, label names the control), kept on every tab; CONTROL: no `layout` and `vertical` draw no grid row; the two tab-rule helpers.

## Acceptance notes

- The horizontal arrangement keys on the viewport `sm` breakpoint, as the dispatch reading asked, not on a container query: a form with no container ancestor would never engage a container variant. Inside a narrow dialog at a wide viewport the label column is still 10rem.
- `SplitForm` and `WizardForm` (plugin-form) also hard-code `layout: 'vertical'` on the form node they build, so a split or wizard form view drops `horizontal` the same way `TabbedForm` did. Outside this card's file surface; reported to the seat.
- On the form page, `type` values `wizard`, `split`, `drawer` and `modal` still draw stacked sections (unchanged; outside this card, reported to the seat).
- A tabbed form-page section with neither `name` nor heading labels its tab with its position number (the app's `TabbedForm` writes an English `Tab N`); no catalogue key exists for either.

## Verification

All readings on head `763ea858` (branch tip after merging `origin/main`) unless noted.

<details><summary>New tests and wider suites</summary>

- New files: 3 files, 21 tests, all pass (5 + 3 + 13).
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/components/src/renderers/form/ packages/plugin-form/ apps/console/src/components/` under the verify lock: Test Files 333 passed (333), Tests 3538 passed, 18 skipped; VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Type check: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components run type-check`, `@object-ui/plugin-form`, `@object-ui/console` each exit 0 (console after its closure build `--filter '@object-ui/console^...'`, VERDICT command-exit 0).
- ESLint on the six changed source and test files: 0 errors (warnings are pre-existing `any` / exhaustive-deps lines).
- `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each restored, blob equal to HEAD, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

Run with `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the pre-merge head `51be1b76`; each anchor hit once and the mutation was verified on disk. The three test files import their subject by relative path, so no dist leg.

- form renderer: `? cn(colSpanClass, HORIZONTAL_FIELD_ITEM_CLASS)` replaced by `? colSpanClass || undefined` turns 3 tests red (grid classes, sm-prefix, label-less field).
- TabbedForm: `layout: schema.layout ?? 'vertical',` replaced by `layout: 'vertical',` turns 1 test red (every field on every tab horizontal).
- FormPage tabs: `tabbedView` forced false turns 5 tests red (strip, defaultTab, tab click, tabPosition, refused submit opens the tab). The submit-carries-every-field test stays green on stacked sections, as a guard should.
- FormPage rows: `horizontalRows` forced false turns 2 tests red.
</details>

<details><summary>Geometry in Chromium</summary>

The item and row classes compiled with the repository's Tailwind 4 (`compile` from `tailwindcss`, which emitted the `not(label)` child rule) and drawn in the preinstalled Chromium. At 1024px: label x 16 width 160, input x 192, label vertically inside the input's box, description under the input at x 192. At 375px: label above the input, both at x 16. One-off measurement, not committed.
</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 34 families on this change set (same list before and after the merge). Each ran on `763ea858` with its exit code captured before any pipe: 34 of 34 exit 0. `dispatch-gates --ran`: 34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` is among them (exit 0). On the pre-merge head the `ui/scripts` vitest family first exited 1 on two tree-walking tests that timed out at 15 s while a 20-minute locked suite shared the box; rerun under the lock it passed (175 files), and it passed again on `763ea858`.
</details>
